import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0134 (m n : ℕ) (h : m ≥ n) : m^3 ≥ n^3 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0134 (m n : ℕ) (h : m ≥ n) : m^3 ≥ n^3 := by
  induction m with m ih
  · have : n^3 ≤ n^3 := by rw [le_refl]
    exact this
  · have : (m + 1) * (m + 1) * (m + 1) ≥ n * n * n := by
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (m + 1) (m + 1), mul_comm (m + 1)]
      have : (m + 1) * (m + 1) ≥ n * n := by
        rw [← add_one_mul, add_le_add h ih, add_le_add_left h 0]
        exact le_refl (m + 1)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (by norm_num)
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_left this (m + 1)) (by norm_num)
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0134 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0134 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0134

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0134
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0134
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
